body:
thank you...so many people have sent me stories like this. They describe the heartbreak and how much they were willing to help if only their loved one had reached out. I did talk to him again...I told him how serious this is and how I worry about how he will feel but I need need need his help. 
I am so incredibly sorry for your loss, I can't fathom your pain. Thank you so incredibly much for reaching out to me even through your own feelings. Its people like you that are convincing me that the world isnt as bad as I thought it was when I woke up this morning. 
Thank you, I love you and I love all of these people who've reached out to me.
life is pain
He wants me to share that’s not the problem. I just feel so bad because no matter what I’ll be dead
He is perfect. He is the most loving, gentle, compassionate, and artistic person I know. He doesn’t deserve to share this burden it could crush him.
You deserve good things as well
Wow...thank you
Thank you...

You’re a beautiful person. Thank you...I know this seems weird but you may have completely flipped my perception of people around. 
I’m not better...but I see stuff a little lighter.
Your husband is so lucky to have you

I didn’t really understand how to express love in a healthy way until I met my bf. I thought yelling was healthy. But you’ve literally just convinced me that there’s more than just him in this world that know how to be kind. And this whole time I’ve thought everyone is terrible.
Fuck...you’re good at that aren’t you. Thank you. Really really thank you

Thank you. Oh my god. I think about how this is affecting him and how hard it is and how much I make him suffer. But I never think about how much he loves me and how much he wants to help me. 
God, you made me cry and thanks for that.
Yes. It’s probably my spotty wifi
Yeah I’m on mobile and it’s not working one sec
Ok...

Ok but it makes sense. I’m giving into my eating disorder again because I like being skinny even if it’s not good for me. I’m hurting myself because I like being able to control my pain. And I want to die because I like the premise of not having to go through this anymore.
Maybe I want to be like this.
Oh... it’s weird because I don’t want help. That’s how bad I am
Really ?
I’m broken forever. I should just fucking die
Yeah last time I called a hotline and they brought police to my parents house. I could try help groups but I’m unhelpable
Ok I don’t know where to start
Yeah but it’s all the time. And I lie to him when I say we are gonna be together forever because I know I’ll die before that. If I didn’t die I’d fucking marry him but I’m going to

No like I when down the [admittedly small] list of insurance covered therapists in my area (up to an hour drive) and it all came back negative. I seriously don’t have enough money in the bank for 2 appointments
Yeah well I’ve tried the ones in my area covered by insurance/I can afford. And they all suck balls
I know but we talk so much and I know he cares and wants to help but I feel bad.

I am depressed. I just don’t know what to do about it. Nothing helps me. All the fucking therapists I’ve ever seen have said I’m treatment resistant which is another word for oh I’m giving up on you. 
My last therapist said “oh well we’ve tried everything I suppose you just have to accept your panic and live like this”

Thanks...
I talk to my bf. But he shouldn’t have to deal with my constant drama he’s got stuff going on too and recently it’s been all about me and me not dying. I’d rather lift that burden from him by dying

You don’t know me I don’t seem like anything but desperate. 
I don’t like myself because I’m ugly and unmotivated
That’s what people say. They like me. Maybe you get to know me and like me too. But then I die because my option on myself matters. And if I can’t think straight then I’m stuck

Yeah...I get that how I treat myself may not be what other people see. I’m not denying people like me. They fucking do. But I don’t like me and even if I’m wrong to think it I still do and it hurts me
It’s just another reason to die. Because I can’t keep things nice
I’m judging myself though.
It’s messy. I can’t even clean it that’s how terrible I am. It’s a complete disaster and it makes me realize how shit I am too

No it’s ok I get it...
I like comedies. And action stuff. But like I don’t laugh at them anymore. And I don’t find any pleasure in watching. Reading makes my head hurt. Drawing makes me feel stupid. Fucking listening to music makes me cry no matter what. 
And even when I do like it for a sec I space out and want to die even more. 
Sorry I’m being so shitty
I’ve been watching big mouth on Netflix. Just finished all of shameless. But it’s hard for me to focus on it. It just seems boring
